caption:
Higher prices. Same POC. It won't HOLD. 📊

Price broke the morning range and ran 60 points, but the developing POC never left 24,410 and the new high printed thin volume. Price moved, value didn't: the market was out of balance without acceptance. With no business being done up there, the move rotated straight back to the POC.

1️⃣ Track the developing POC every 30 minutes
2️⃣ Price far from value while the POC stays behind = no acceptance
3️⃣ Fade the move back toward the POC, not toward the next high
